resources.string: Pair with your Server to start listening.
Connect to the Server you paired on this phone.
Address must include a port, for example host:47820.
The port must be a number.
The port must be between 1 and 65535.
The host may contain only letters, digits, dots, and hyphens.
A raw IPv6 address must be enclosed in brackets, for example [::1]:47820.
A bracketed host must be an IPv6 address.
Enter the Server address as host:port.
No saved pairing. Pair with the Server first.
Camera permission was denied. Paste the pairing link instead.
The code does not match the one shown on the Server.
This is not a valid Audio Share pairing link.
This app never falls back to v1.
No jitter buffer, concealment, or clock-drift correction. Audio quality is best-effort.
One Client per Server. Concurrent phones are not supported.
No diagnostics export, no telemetry, and no raw-audio recording.
The v1 app sends audio without encryption or authentication. Use v1 only on a trusted network. This v2 beta is the encrypted, authenticated client; a v2 failure never downgrades to v1.
Updates are manual. Download the new APK from the GitHub Release page and verify its SHA-256 checksum before installing. There is no in-app updater.
This beta has no telemetry and does not record raw audio.
Media session active. Audio plays while the screen is locked.
The pairing failed or its invitation is no longer valid. Ask the Server to start a new pairing, then use the fresh QR code or pairing code. The Server must still accept this device.
This phone is not paired with the Server
Pair the phone again. The Server does not recognize this identity.
The Server rejected the identity proof
Re-pair the phone. If the problem repeats, check the Server clock and identity files.
Ask the Server operator to pair this device again. A revoked device cannot reconnect.
The Server identity does not match the saved pin
Verify you are connecting to the right Server, then remove the saved pairing and pair again. The saved pin is never replaced automatically.
The ten-minute pairing exchange deadline passed. Start a new pairing on the Server and use the fresh QR code or pairing code.
Wait a moment; the app retries automatically with bounded backoff.
Wait a minute before trying again. Repeated failures are rate-limited by the Server.
Another session took over this device
This session was closed because the same device connected elsewhere. Reconnect if needed.
The Server and app disagreed on the wire format. Update the app or report the issue.
Reconnect. If this repeats, report the issue.
This phone cannot play the Server audio format
Ask the Server operator to choose a supported PCM format.
The Server has no audio to send
Wait for the Server to start capture, then retry.
The Server stopped sending audio. Reconnect to continue.
The Server is shutting down; reconnect after it restarts.
Check the network. The app retries automatically with bounded backoff.
The network path cannot carry audio
Reconnect. If the network is blocking UDP, switch networks or use a VPN.
Reconnect and try again. If this keeps happening, report the issue.
Use the QR code or pairing code shown on the Server.
Point the camera at the QR code on the Server.
Preparing a secure pairing exchange. Keep this screen open.
Confirmed. Waiting for the Server to accept this device.
The QR code verified the Server identity. This phone confirms automatically; the Server operator still needs to accept it.
Check that this code matches the one shown on the Server, then enter it below.
Enter the code shown on the Server
Confirmed. Waiting for the Server to accept this device.
If the Server operator declines this device, the QR code must be refreshed.
If the Server operator declines this device, start a new pairing.
Saving this pairing. The app will connect automatically as soon as the Server accepts this device.
The invitation cannot be reused. Ask the Server to show a fresh QR code.
Start a new pairing on the Server before trying again.
The camera stays closed until you choose Scan again.
